fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/model fold a log of the 01M6WMCCRC0K shape (one change set updates and renames a node, then retires it on the old base) with no problems and land it; still report a conflict when another change set's overlapping op sits after the base, including one interleaved between the change set's own ops; and still report the target as retired (ErrRetired or a conflict, never an applied write) when one change set retires a target and then writes it again on a base older than the retire, for both node and link ops; go test -trimpath ./internal/model/... passes.
fields.statement: An op is never stale against its own change set's ops: a base superseded only by the same change set's earlier ops on the target folds and lands with no conflict, while other change sets' overlapping ops after the base still conflict.
